Summary: Malformed date/status/stage filter params reach Postgres raw
Root Cause: Unvalidated query params passed straight into Sequelize WHERE on typed columns
Repro: GET /api/projects?closingFrom=not-a-date returned raw Postgres 500
Fix (file:line evidence): lib/projectStore.ts buildProjectWhere() - isValidDate/status whitelist added

Summary: Double-pay race on reimbursement/BOM/travel payment completion
Root Cause: Read-then-write status check with no lock; 3 of 5 payment sources lacked the guard the other 2 already had
Repro: Two concurrent accounts-complete calls both pass stale status check
Fix (file:line evidence): lib/reimbursementSheetStore.ts / lib/tmsBomRequestStore.ts markPaymentDone / lib/travelScheduleStore.ts completeBooking - conditional UPDATE WHERE status=expected

Summary: Duplicate-username race on user creation leaks raw DB error
Root Cause: createUser() check-then-create with only a DB unique constraint as backstop; constraint violation unhandled
Repro: Two concurrent POST /api/admin/users with same username
Fix (file:line evidence): lib/userStore.ts createUser() - catch SequelizeUniqueConstraintError -> clean 409

Summary: Leave-claim/escalation/warning-waive double-decision race

Repro: Two concurrent decide/waive/ack calls both succeed
Fix (file:line evidence): lib/dailyReportLeaveClaimStore.ts decideClaim / acknowledgeEscalation; lib/dailyReportWarningStore.ts waiveWarning/reinstateWarning - conditional UPDATE

Summary: Accept/decline/approve/reject race on marketing requests
Root Cause: Two different people's actions race each other (not just double-click) - accept vs reassign; approve vs reject
Repro: Concurrent accept+decline or approve+reject on same request both succeed
Fix (file:line evidence): lib/marketingRequestStore.ts - new updateGuarded() with SELECT...FOR UPDATE in transaction

Summary: Duplicate procurement record from concurrent send-to-procurement
Root Cause: Unguarded status-check-then-write; worst case creates a DUPLICATE DB ROW not just a duplicate notification
Repro: Two concurrent send-to-procurement calls both create a TmsProcurement row
Fix (file:line evidence): lib/tmsBomRequestStore.ts - 5 transitions (approve/reject/admin/finance/send-to-procurement) guarded

Summary: Status-change race fires misleading email
Root Cause: updateQuotationStatus read-then-write with no guard
Repro: Two concurrent status changes (approve racing reject) both succeed
Fix (file:line evidence): lib/quotationStore.ts updateQuotationStatus - conditional UPDATE + 409

Summary: Partner quotation-request response race shares two different quotations

Repro: Two concurrent responses to same partner request
Fix (file:line evidence): lib/partnerQuotationRequestStore.ts respondToQuotationRequest - row lock (LOCK.UPDATE) in transaction

Summary: CSV export formula injection (real - unlike Accounts' already-protected export)
Root Cause: csvEscape only handled quotes/commas/newlines, not =/+/-/@ formula triggers
Repro: Client name starting with = exports as live Excel formula
Fix (file:line evidence): lib/quotationStore.ts csvEscape - neutralize formula-trigger chars on string fields only

Summary: Support ticket / demo / project-review races

Fix (file:line evidence): lib/partnerDemoStore.ts cancelPartnerDemo; lib/partnerProjectStore.ts respondToInfoRequest/reviseSubmission - guarded updates

Summary: Unguarded admin-decide/submit branches + real access-control hole
Root Cause: 5 remaining lifecycle transitions unguarded; GET /api/travel-schedule/[id] had ZERO authorization check - any employee could view any other's travel request by UUID
Repro: No auth check on detail GET; guessable-UUID IDOR
Fix (file:line evidence): lib/travelScheduleStore.ts - canViewTravelRequest() added to GET; 5 transitions guarded

Summary: Task-status race + unvalidated date reaching DATEONLY column
Root Cause: Same TOCTOU + same unvalidated-date class as BUG-001
Repro: Concurrent status transitions; garbage start_date/due_date
Fix (file:line evidence): lib/tmsTaskStore.ts update()/recordTaskUpdate(); app/api/tms/tasks routes - isValidDateOnly validation

Summary: Concurrent "add update" silently discards one person's entry
Root Cause: Read-modify-write on full updates ARRAY (not a status flag) - genuine lost write, not just a race window
Repro: Two concurrent addUpdate calls on same visit - one entry vanishes
Fix (file:line evidence): lib/siteVisitStore.ts addUpdate() - row-locked append-only INSERT replacing read-modify-write

Summary: Unvalidated employeeId (SQLi-shaped and nonexistent) leaks raw 500
Root Cause: No UUID/existence validation before UUID-cast / FK insert
Repro: GET weekly-update?employeeId=' OR 1=1 --; POST with all-zero UUID
Fix (file:line evidence): app/api/targets/weekly-update/route.ts; app/api/targets/route.ts - isUuid + existence check

Summary: TeamCheckboxes keyed by raw name, collides when 2 people share a display name
Root Cause: React list keyed by name string only, no id available in this component's name-based selection model
Repro: Two same-named QA fixtures on Demo Schedule triggered duplicate-key React warning
Fix (file:line evidence): components/TeamCheckboxes.tsx - keyed by `${name}-${i}`

Summary: Stored XSS via file upload - any authenticated user can plant executable HTML
Root Cause: Upload endpoint trusted client-declared Content-Type with zero allowlist, served it back identically with no nosniff
Repro: Upload evil.html with forged Content-Type:text/html + <script> tag -> stored and served with script intact
Fix (file:line evidence): lib/fileStorage.ts sniffContentType()/safeServeHeaders(); app/api/uploads/file/[...path]/route.ts; app/api/site-visits/image/[...path]/route.ts

Summary: No brute-force/lockout protection on login
Root Cause: Zero throttling on failed login attempts - any account brute-forceable
Repro: 20 rapid wrong-password attempts all 401 with zero delay
Fix (file:line evidence): lib/loginHistoryStore.ts isLoginLocked() - 8 failures/15min lockout reusing existing LoginHistory table

Summary: Password change does not invalidate other active sessions
Root Cause: Stateless token scheme with zero revocation mechanism
Repro: Token B (pre-change) still authenticates after password change via token A
Fix (file:line evidence): lib/auth.ts SessionPayload.sessionEpoch; lib/userStore.ts touchSessionEpoch; wired to dedicated users.sessionEpoch column (see BUG-023)
Status: FIXED - live HTTP-verified (dev server restarted, 2-device + password-change test all passed)

Summary: Logout has zero server-side effect
Root Cause: Logout only cleared client cookie - same scheme as BUG-019
Repro: Replayed the exact just-logged-out token - still authenticates
Fix (file:line evidence): Same mechanism as BUG-019 - app/api/auth/logout/route.ts touchSessionEpoch
Status: FIXED - live HTTP-verified (logout correctly 401s both the logged-out session and the other device's session)

Summary: "undefined Paise" on printed financial documents (ordinary inputs, not an edge case)
Root Cause: Math.round((num-rupees)*100) can land on exactly 100 before the amount itself is rounded; twoDigit(100) returns undefined
Repro: Three ordinary reimbursement line items summing via float drift
Fix (file:line evidence): lib/numberToWords.ts numberToIndianWords() - round amount to nearest paise BEFORE splitting + defensive carry

Summary: PATCH/POST on ticket lacked ticket-specific scoping (GET had it, PATCH/POST didn't)
Root Cause: GET correctly scoped via canViewTicket; PATCH (status/triage) and POST (comments incl. internal notes) only checked role type, not assignment to THIS ticket
Repro: Engineer not assigned to a ticket could still transition its status / plant internal comment by guessing its id
Fix (file:line evidence): app/api/support/tickets/[id]/route.ts - canViewTicket() check added to PATCH+POST

Severity: P1 (Design flaw introduced then fixed same session)
Summary: sessionEpoch reused lastLoginAt - a 2nd login silently kills 1st device's session
Root Cause: lastLoginAt already re-stamped on every ordinary login (pre-existing); BUG-019/020 fix reused that column as revocation epoch without accounting for this
Repro: Logging in from tab B killed tab A's session even without any logout
Fix (file:line evidence): db/models/user.js dedicated sessionEpoch column (migration 20261105100000); lib/userStore.ts touchSessionEpoch/findUserStatusById; app/api/auth/login/route.ts reads-not-bumps
Status: FIXED - live HTTP-verified (dev server restarted; Device A confirmed to survive Device B's login)

Summary: Project-code collision race on concurrent create

Repro: Two concurrent tmsProjectStore.create() calls sharing one pre-computed code

Summary: Unvalidated TMS-project dates reach DATEONLY column raw
